notes.title: Farlands Journey is OUT NOW on Steam!
notes.content:
Embark on an epic adventure through mysterious lands, uncover hidden secrets, and face thrilling challenges. The journey begins today![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585951/73350877feda61abfd75d02edc0b6fef786bf245.png"]10% discount on start!
Don't miss the opportunity to buy the game at a bargain price.
And also don't forget to leave a review about our game.



Game features:

12 completely different locations

8 types of enemies and 4 bosses

11 hats that give different special abilities

8 types of magic wands

many secret places

aesthetics of graphics and music from 8-16-bit consoles



Let the adventure begin!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585951/9c5cf07cc2163f671652c09fcdb7cde07d94b1a4.png"]
